Country or region name

description: Binary: 1 for ETS_EU_IS, ETS_EU_LI, ETS_EU_NO (EFTA participation in EU ETS)

description: Binary: 1 if CPI is in implemented status in this year
notes: Uses date-range derivation; takes priority over all other statuses

description: Binary: 1 if CPI is under development in this year
notes: Priority 2 in status hierarchy; mutually exclusive with implemented

description: Binary: 1 if CPI is under consideration in this year
notes: Priority 3 in status hierarchy; mutually exclusive with higher statuses

description: Binary: 1 if any of implemented/under_development/under_consideration = 1
Binary: 1 if end_year is not NaN and year > end_year
Ordinal status: 3=Implemented, 2=Under development, 1=Under consideration, 0=None/Abolished
notes: Mutually exclusive; uses priority hierarchy

description: Binary: 1 if CPI covers the power sector
notes: 0 if CPI not present in S&T edition for that year

Binary: 1 if CPI covers the road transport sector
Binary: 1 if CPI covers the aviation sector

Binary: 1 if CPI covers the buildings sector
Binary: 1 if CPI covers the waste sector
Binary: 1 if CPI covers the agriculture sector
Binary: 1 if CPI covers the forestry sector
Integer count of sectors covered (0-9)
Original comma-separated sector string (audit trail)

description: Binary: 1 if CPI appears in sectoral coverage data for this year

description: Annual carbon price in USD (converted from LCU at April 1 exchange rate)
notes: NaN if no price data available for that CPI-year

description: World Bank income group of the country

description: World Bank region
Original currency code before USD conversion
Binary: 1 if year >= 2019 (CBAM Commission proposal treatment indicator)
Binary: 1 if year >= 2021 (CBAM legislation treatment indicator)
Binary: 1 if year >= 2023 (CBAM implementation treatment indicator)
First year this CPI covered industry sector within 2016-2026 panel. 0 = never-treated.

description: Binary: 1 if covers_industry=0 in ALL years 2016-2026
notes: Clean control group for Callaway & Sant'Anna DiD estimator

description: Binary: 1 if first_year_industry == 2016 (had industry coverage in panel start year)

description: Categorical: always_treated / never_treated / new_cpi_with_industry / genuine_expansion

description: First year this CPI reached implemented status within 2016-2026. 0 = never.

description: Average CBAM exposure 2014-2024 (static regressor)
